text: Most health insurance claims in India get rejected. My uncle paid for 8 years and when he got admitted they rejected it saying pre-existing disease. It's a scam.

chain.why: Only a small fraction of claims are rejected.

conclusion: Only a small fraction of claims are rejected, insurers cannot reject a claim for non‑disclosure after five years, a significant share of Indian adults have diabetes or high blood pressure, and a private‑hospital stay typically costs tens of thousands of rupees out of pocket.

text: Those are just official numbers. My uncle paid for 8 years and they still rejected him for a pre-existing disease. How is that fair?

I understand your concern. According to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business, 29 May 2024, para 13, after five years of continuous cover an insurer can’t reject a claim for non‑disclosure or misrepresentation, except in cases of established fraud; policy exclusions still apply. Would knowing this rule change how you view the situation?
